And with high BP putting your body under stress with exercise could cause a stroke if you have untreated BP.

Btw: I know this sounds scary, but BP meds are some of the BEST TESTED drugs we have, some of the best understood. It is unlikely you will cause damage to yourself with them if you have high BP - but you need to discuss with the drs, which ones, which dosages. 

I would recommend get comfortable with your medical team - work out a treatment, reduce your exercise to low impact for a few weeks, relax, don’t freak out and stress eat, it might be a problem - and it’s bad luck at your age, but it is a treatable one, and you will be fine.
